event_budget.note: required_event_time_ms must include the configured regulation sequence, recovery censor window, and persistence/transition margin; eligibility does not invent that duration from wall-clock state.

notes: Eligibility is evaluated atomically before challenge_event_id is opened.
Suppressed candidates do not create recovery events.
The first Phase 0 challenge family is explicit A↔B rule switch only; hidden switching is prohibited.
The rule-switch event is not conditioned on an error or observed destabilization; selecting only events that visibly perturb performance would condition the sample on a post-challenge response.
The 30 s interchallenge interval and maximum of three challenges per session remain candidate pacing values to be ratified with the final safety/session design before participant recruitment.
Every core recovery event requires a target-rule recovery reference for B. Timing qualification only governs whether the same reference can also support S/V.
